mechanism.claim: Under elevated VIX, same-sign one-session changes in both the 9D/VIX and VIX/3M log slopes identify a coherent volatility-curve impulse: joint steepening transmits risk-off pressure to BTC (short), while joint cooling transmits relief (long) for 24 elapsed hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: CVCIR is a first-difference curve-coherence impulse with no tail or option-flow input. CVSRC was a rare joint tail-plus-term level crossing; CVTR and related clocks were static ranked level states.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: an official Cboe next-session curve-impulse clock is external to BTC activity and absent from Gross9

features.vix_strict_prior_midrank: 252 valid observations, minimum 126; current appended after rank
features.deltas: current minus immediately previous exact common source observation; no calendar fill

clock.trigger: false-to-true onset of each same-sign impulse state; direct switch from opposite state is a new onset
clock.entry: first later exact common Cboe source date at 09:35 America/New_York
clock.reservation: global half-open, entry equal to prior exit accepted

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, sign, hold, or subset repair.
